5beef1b2ab8f0.title: From a pioneer in optical networking to becoming the global leader in high-speed connectivity, we continue to innovate, evolve, and push boundaries — all with  focus on empowering out customers to run on confidence.
5beef1b2ab8f0.textContent: From a pioneer in optical networking to becoming the global leader in high-speed connectivity, we continue to innovate, evolve, and push boundaries—all with a focus on empowering our customers to run on confidence.

5beef2dfab8f3.title: Ciena’s success led to its initial publi
5beef2dfab8f3.textContent: Ciena’s success led to its initial public offering in February 1997, at which time Ciena achieved a market capitalization of $3.4 billion (USD).

5c1a794c625a9.title: Ciena was incorporated and quickly found
5c1a794c625a9.textContent: Ciena was incorporated and quickly found success pioneering dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) technology, enabling the transport of greater volumes of information across networks.

5c1a9d0d625ad.title: Ciena’s long-haul optical transport plat
5c1a9d0d625ad.textContent: Ciena’s long-haul optical transport platform enabled a service provider to transmit more than three million phone calls across a single fiber pair.

5c1a9d64625ae.title: Ciena achieved annual revenue of $1.6 bi
5c1a9d64625ae.textContent: Ciena achieved annual revenue of $1.6 billion (USD), with its market capitalization reaching nearly $30 billion (USD).

5c1a9e07625af.title: Despite a market downturn, Ciena made si
5c1a9e07625af.textContent: Despite a market downturn, Ciena made six bold acquisitions, investing heavily in its product portfolio and enhancing product functionality.

5c1ab182625b0.title: Ciena established Ciena Cares as a donat
5c1ab182625b0.textContent: Ciena established Ciena Cares as a donation-matching program, which has since evolved into a global community engagement program and a cornerstone of Ciena's culture.

5c1ab955625b1.title: Ciena acquired Nortel Networks' Metro Et
5c1ab955625b1.textContent: Ciena acquired Nortel Networks' Metro Ethernet Networks (MEN), providing access to more diversified expertise and deeper technology toolkit. With this acquisition, Ciena became the largest global supplier focused exclusively on the transition to converged optical-Ethernet–based networking.

5c1aba83625b3.title: To initiate another game-changing indust
5c1aba83625b3.textContent: To initiate another game-changing industry shift, Ciena acquired Cyan—making it possible for customers to better tune, control, and adjust their networks.

5c1abbc1625b5.title: Ciena acquired Packet Design and DonRive
5c1abbc1625b5.textContent: Ciena acquired Packet Design and DonRiver to support the broadest range of closed-loop automation use cases and to further advance the Blue Planet® Intelligent Automation Portfolio.

5c1abb59625b4.title: Ciena announced the availability of its
5c1abb59625b4.textContent: Ciena announced the availability of its WaveLogic  coherent modem technology to optical component leaders Lumentum, NeoPhotonics, and Oclaro—addressing the industry’s shift toward disaggregated models and facilitating greater choice for network operators.

5e0a40f57cad2.title: Ciena added service assurance analytics
5e0a40f57cad2.textContent: Ciena added service assurance analytics and network performance management capabilities to round out its comprehensive software portfolio through the acquisition of Centina.

63d167db67d26.altText: Group of female students connected by Ciena's digital inclusion program.

63d1699d67d28.title: As part of Ciena's dedication to drive d
63d1699d67d28.textContent: As part of Ciena's dedication to drive digital inclusion, Ciena committed $10 million (USD) over five years to improve opportunities for underserved students worldwide through greater connectivity.

63d16de567d2e.title: Ciena acquired AT&T's Vyatta virtual rou
63d16de567d2e.textContent: Ciena acquired AT&T's Vyatta virtual routing and switching technology to extend its ability to help customers create virtualized networks and support 5G, enterprise, and cloud use cases.

6763361c099dc.title: Ciena delivered the industry’s first 1.6
6763361c099dc.textContent: Ciena delivered the industry’s first 1.6 Tb/s coherent solution and achieved record technology milestones across both terrestrial and submarine networks.

697907fcd378d.title: Ciena acquired Benu Networks and Tibit C
697907fcd378d.textContent: Ciena acquired Benu Networks and Tibit Communications to offer fully integrated broadband access solutions that combine routing, subscriber management, and PON features and functionality to address residential broadband, enterprise business services, and fixed-wireless access use cases.

69790a74d3793.title: Ciena acquired Nubis Communications to a
69790a74d3793.textContent: Ciena acquired Nubis Communications to address rapidly growing demand for scalable, high-performance connectivity inside the data center, driven by the explosive growth of AI-related traffic.

69a72666fdc6b.title: Ciena acquired TeraXion’s indium phosphi
69a72666fdc6b.textContent: Ciena acquired TeraXion’s indium phosphide and silicon photonics component assets to strengthen its WaveLogic  coherent optics and enable more programmable network scaling.
